links.note: where Sudama was going -> to his friend Krishna; 32243 is Sudama asking the way to Deendayal's house and naming himself
how the man at the door was dressed -> his dhoti torn; 32242 is the doorkeeper's description, no turban, no jhanga, a torn dhoti
how Krishna saw Sudama's condition -> pitiable; 32244 is Karunanidhi weeping at that sight
how Krishna washed his feet -> with his own tears; 32244 word for word
what Sudama's wife sent for Krishna -> tandul; 32247 is 'bhabhi ke tandul'
where he kept the bundle of rice -> under his arm; 32245 is Krishna asking why he keeps the potli pressed in his kaankh
